E.style: restriction-first, adversarial prior art, construction probe

comparison_limits: One run per arm; same parent-model family but backend snapshot/token billing unavailable.
Equal query/candidate ceilings, not demonstrated equal inference cost or equal search-engine mix.
No human-expert trial, randomized replication or blinded evaluation.
Expert arm additionally executed an inexpensive finite probe; candidate outputs are not comparable quantitative discovery scores.

candidates.title: Mine-waste resource qualification
candidates.value: Identify waste bodies worth sampling for recoverable minerals
candidates.limitation: Historical material identity, present mineralogy and extractability are not established by inventory coordinates
candidates.discovery: Link processing history to present physical stockpiles
candidates.construct: Source-linked district dossiers followed by blinded identity review and independent sampling
candidates.inheritance: Source links, coordinate/unit code, rejected identities and assays
candidates.disposition: No demonstrated advance over survey/geological consultancy; desk work cannot establish recovery. Not selected.

candidates.title: Recovered crop-accession trait evidence
candidates.value: Connect usable living accessions with credible trait observations
candidates.limitation: Identity, paper records, viability and seed availability can all block use
candidates.change: Agent archive parsing and current digitization resources
candidates.discovery: Treat accession identity and physical availability as joint obligations
candidates.construct: Curator-blinded record recovery plus greenhouse tests
candidates.inheritance: Accession aliases, trial context, availability and negative results
candidates.disposition: Data-recovery and breeding methods precede candidate; biological validation unavailable. Not selected.

candidates.title: Restore unsupported scientific instruments
candidates.value: Return working hardware to maintainable control
candidates.limitation: Obsolete interfaces/software and bespoke qualification effort
candidates.change: Capable coding agents and open replacement hardware
candidates.construct: Protocol emulator and two-lab reference measurement comparison
candidates.inheritance: Protocol, simulator, traces, calibration and build recipes
candidates.disposition: Established retrofitting engineering; repeatable neglected niche unproved. Not selected.

candidates.title: Scientific claims from unresolved archival measurements
candidates.beneficiary: Archive scientists and observational research groups
candidates.value: Obtain an auditable answer without resolving every ambiguous entry
candidates.limitation: Complete transcription can dominate; loose independent intervals lose dependence; source-model completeness remains hard
candidates.change: Current agents may construct heterogeneous semantic models more cheaply, untested
candidates.discovery: Connect archival metrology with certain-answer semantics, retaining shared nuisance and fallible-source structure
candidates.construct: Exact finite bounds/witness instrument, independent exhaustive comparison, fresh recipient execution
candidates.mechanism: Conditional fixed-scope question package with truthful unresolved outcomes and separately defined acceptance
candidates.inheritance: Executable finite solver, source/assumption schema, counterexamples, refusal tests and prior-art record
candidates.disposition: Chosen for falsification, NOT admitted as flagship. Core methods established; practical source-construction advantage unmeasured.

candidates.title: Causal bounds from aggregate or incomplete evidence
candidates.value: Conservative causal inference without fabricated microdata
candidates.limitation: Point identification absent, eliciting correct assumptions hard
candidates.change: Agents can compile heterogeneous evidence into formal constraints
candidates.discovery: Translate published summaries to explicit possible data-generating models
candidates.construct: Binary finite causal-bound case with missingness and mismeasurement
candidates.inheritance: Estimand and constraint translations plus countermodels
candidates.disposition: Duarte et al. already establish automated discrete causal bounding. Rejected as novelty headline.

candidates.title: Physical observables eliminating inaccessible nuisance fields
candidates.value: Test physics using measurable fields without reconstructing all hidden states
candidates.limitation: Boundary terms and sensor/nuisance models require justified domain structure
candidates.change: Agent symbolic construction and exact checking
candidates.discovery: Compile inaccessible-state restrictions to nuisance-annihilating observables
candidates.construct: Exact nullspace witness then held-out weak-form PDE
candidates.inheritance: Equations, boundary obligations and failure witnesses
candidates.disposition: Weak-form symbolic discovery and experiment-design prior art cover central idea. Rejected.

candidates.title: Chemistry-generated fingerprints for ambiguous metabolites
candidates.value: Resolve structures through independent reaction responses
candidates.limitation: Mass signatures ambiguous; predicted reactions can be wrong
candidates.discovery: View independent reactions as error-tolerant experimental queries
candidates.construct: Blinded measured standards and uncertainty-aware decoder
candidates.inheritance: Measured reaction outcomes, failures and distinguishability witnesses
candidates.disposition: MCheM already combines orthogonal chemical labeling and annotation. Additional physical channels unbuilt; rejected.

novelty_verdict: No candidate establishes both independent opportunity discovery and a substantive advance beyond the strongest identified prior art.
root_refinement: Four additional targeted queries added KR2020 certain-answer aggregation, VLDB2008 query cleaning, DRAW automation and the human-assisted climate transcription comparison. They strengthen the prior-art challenge rather than establish novelty.
researcher_supplied: Initial user brief and evaluation requirements
Agent-authored possible-world structures, numerical examples, thresholds and economic distributions
Root-authored test generator and acceptance conditions
agent_contributions: Seven candidate hypotheses not given as final applications in the brief
An exact bounded construction and negative control
Executable tests, fresh artifact transfer and conditional economics
